unfed.why: only starts a child execution of this same workflow (When Executed by Another Workflow); its reads are the child's steps

a Code node that requires the npm package youtube-transcript and fetches the transcript from YouTube itself; n8n 2.47.7's JS task runner refuses the require (NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL unset, the package is not in the image: "Module 'youtube-transcript' is disallowed"), so no source can feed it

branches: no IF/Switch; the agent decides whether to call youtube_video_analyzer (expected: once, which returns the child's error)
expect.offline: Get YouTube Transcript requires the npm package youtube-transcript. n8n 2.47.7 refuses it in every variant whatever the data: the JS task runner allows no external module unless NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_EXTERNAL names it, the bench sets none, and the image does not ship the package (task-runner require-resolver; confirmed 2026-11-16 by running the template's Code node alone in the bench's n8n: "Module 'youtube-transcript' is disallowed [line 7]"). The require sits outside the code's try, so the Code node fails, the tool's child execution fails after Get YouTube Video Details has run, and the agent gets the tool's error text (ToolWorkflow v1: There was an error: "…") instead of the transcript; the chat reply still comes. When Executed by Another Workflow keeps the template's pinData (videoId JWfNLF_g_V0). Window Buffer Memory holds one turn per run. The Google API key is a template placeholder the overlay fills
